tagline: Turn a multimodal idea into a documented, testable experiment.
introduction: A research and developer companion for Google DeepMind's public work and the Gemini API documentation, focusing on clear capability boundaries and evaluation.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Google DeepMind? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map an AI idea to evidence
capabilities.description: Separate a desired behavior from documented product support and research claims.

capabilities.title: Plan a multimodal evaluation
capabilities.description: Check an invented multimodal plan for split leakage and coverage gaps without claiming model performance.
outputs: declared split leakage, planned coverage and untested capabilities

capabilities.title: Read a research claim carefully
capabilities.description: Explain a public research summary and its transfer limits.

capabilities.title: Design Google DeepMind challenge support
capabilities.description: Separate Gemini-core and Gemma-open-model experiment owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Gemini API meaningfully enables innovative core functionality with actual inputs/results; separate Gemma open-model path demonstrates impactful use and exact model/runtime;compare grounded quality/latency
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

starterPrompts: Plan a source-backed separate gemini-core and gemma-open-model experiment owner task for this challenge.

Prepare a bounded peer-agent handoff with input evidence, expected output, source revision and explicit unknowns.
